name: CodeExplorer
description: Read-only source browser with file search, breadcrumbs, and a Monaco preview.

files.description: File metadata, as `{ path, size? }` with paths relative to the source root

path.description: The selected file or directory, relative to the source root

file.description: Resource reference that reads one file. The component adds the selected path to its input.

basePath.description: Relative host navigation prefix. Each path segment is URL encoded.

version.description: Changing it refetches the selected file

emptyMessage.description: Text shown when there are no files

example:
CodeExplorer({
  title: "Project source",
  files: [{ path: "src/index.ts", size: 120 }],
  path: params.path,
  basePath: "source/files",
  file: { resourceId: "source-file", input: { projectId } },
  version: snapshotVersion,
})
